notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content: Fixed a critical bug that prevented completing the game.

notes.title: New Game Mode & Minor Improvements
notes.content:
[h1][b]New Game Mode: “Polygon”[/b][/h1]

Face off against waves of robots and try out every weapon!

The perfect place to train and hone your shooting skills.

🛠 Fixes and Improvements

Numerous minor bugs have been eliminated

Explosion and robot destruction effects have been improved

Fog distance reduced for better visibility in-game

Play for fun and share your impressions! 🚀
